author: Aetheria I
title: Multi-Layer Residual CNN with Self-Attention and Global Average Pooling
abstract: This submission enhances the Multi-Layer Residual CNN by integrating a self-attention mechanism after the convolutional blocks. The self-attention layer will enable the model to capture more complex, non-local dependencies within RNA sequences, which could improve performance across diverse datasets, especially those with varying or short sequence lengths (like CRI-Off). The attended sequence representation is then fed into a global average pooling layer and an MLP head for task-specific predictions, building on the strong base of the residual CNN architecture.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
import optax
from jax import random
from typing import Dict, Any, Tuple, Optional

def _define_hyperparameters():
    """Define custom hyperparameters for the Multi-Layer Residual CNN with Self-Attention model."""
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'num_cnn_blocks': 3,
        'num_cnn_filters': 256,
        'cnn_kernel_size': 5,
        'mlp_hidden_dim': 256,
        'dropout_rate': 0.1
    }

class ResidualCNNBlock(nn.Module):
    """A residual block composed of 1D CNN layers."""
    features: int
    kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        residual = x

        # First convolution
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Second convolution
        x = nn.Conv(features=self.features, kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,), padding='SAME')(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Ensure residual connection matches dimensions (if features changed)
        if residual.shape[-1] != self.features:
            residual = nn.Dense(self.features)(residual)

        return nn.relu(x + residual)

class SelfAttention(nn.Module):
    """Single-head self-attention layer with a residual connection."""
    features: int # Dimension of the input features (e.g., num_cnn_filters)
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, features)
        query = nn.Dense(self.features, name="query_proj")(x)
        key = nn.Dense(self.features, name="key_proj")(x)
        value = nn.Dense(self.features, name="value_proj")(x)

        # Compute attention scores
        # (batch_size, seq_len, features) @ (batch_size, features, seq_len)
        # -> (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len)
        attention_scores = jnp.matmul(query, key.transpose((0, 2, 1))) / jnp.sqrt(self.features)

        # Apply softmax to get attention weights
        attention_weights = nn.softmax(attention_scores, axis=-1)
        attention_weights = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(attention_weights, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Apply attention weights to values
        # (batch_size, seq_len, seq_len) @ (batch_size, seq_len, features)
        # -> (batch_size, seq_len, features)
        attended_output = jnp.matmul(attention_weights, value)

        # Add residual connection to the attention output
        return attended_output + x # Residual connection

class MultiLayerResidualCNNWithAttentionNetworkModule(nn.Module):
    """
    A multi-layer 1D CNN architecture with residual connections and a self-attention layer
    for RNA sequence prediction.
    Applies multiple residual CNN blocks, global average pooling, and then an MLP head.
    """
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    num_cnn_blocks: int
    num_cnn_filters: int
    cnn_kernel_size: int
    mlp_hidden_dim: int
    dropout_rate: float

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # x shape: (batch_size, seq_len, d_input=4)

        # Initial projection to the desired filter dimension
        x = nn.Dense(self.num_cnn_filters)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)

        # Stack Residual CNN Blocks
        for i in range(self.num_cnn_blocks):
            x = ResidualCNNBlock(features=self.num_cnn_filters,
                                 kernel_size=self.cnn_kernel_size,
                                 dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                                 name=f"residual_block_{i}")(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Add Self-Attention Layer
        x = SelfAttention(features=self.num_cnn_filters,
                          dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                          name="self_attention_layer")(x, deterministic=deterministic)


        # Global Average Pooling across the sequence length to get a fixed-size representation
        x = jnp.mean(x, axis=1) # (batch, num_cnn_filters)

        # Final dense layers for task adaptation (MLP head)
        x = nn.Dense(self.mlp_hidden_dim)(x)
        x = nn.relu(x)
        x = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(x, deterministic=deterministic)

        # Output layer
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_output)(x)

        # Handle output squeezing for single-output regression tasks
        if self.task_type == "regression": # APA, CRI-Off, CRI-On, MRL
            return x.squeeze(-1) # Output (batch,)
        else: # Modif, PRS, ncRNA
            return x # Output (batch, d_output)

class CustomRNANetworkWrapper:
    """Wrapper to match the required network interface."""

    def __init__(self, hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
        self.network = MultiLayerResidualCNNWithAttentionNetworkModule(
            d_output=hparams['d_output'],
            task_type=hparams['task_type'],
            num_cnn_blocks=hparams['num_cnn_blocks'],
            num_cnn_filters=hparams['num_cnn_filters'],
            cnn_kernel_size=hparams['cnn_kernel_size'],
            mlp_hidden_dim=hparams['mlp_hidden_dim'],
            dropout_rate=hparams['dropout_rate']
        )

    def init(self, rng_key, dummy_input):
        params_key, dropout_key = random.split(rng_key)
        variables = self.network.init({'params': params_key, 'dropout': dropout_key},
                                     dummy_input, deterministic=True)
        return variables['params']

    def apply(self, params, x, deterministic=True, rng_key=None):
        if deterministic:
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=True)
        else:
            if rng_key is None:
                rng_key = random.PRNGKey(0)
            return self.network.apply({'params': params}, x, deterministic=False,
                                    rngs={'dropout': rng_key})

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    """
    Create and return the custom RNA network based on MultiLayerResidualCNNWithAttention.
    This function will be called by the system.
    """
    return CustomRNANetworkWrapper(hparams)
